title: revise after ambush
context: Unexpected attack and presence of two apparently cooperating rivals.
observed_actions: Recognizes that the rivals may have formed a prior alliance.
observed_result: Updates adversary model despite being physically incapacitated.
epistemic_limits: Not proof he knew the alliance before observing it.
information_available: Unexpected attack and presence of two apparently cooperating rivals.
counterfactual_test: Two rivals independently claimed neutrality but are observed coordinating. Revises coalition hypothesis and accounts for injury or exhaustion. Reject: Assumes prior omniscience or ignores physical impairment.
